prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-05, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-02-05):
| Return 3m            | +17.7% |
| Return 1m            | +9.7% |
| Return 1w            | +10.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 94% |
| 21d realized vol     | 31% |
| Last close           | 283.50 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown strong short- to mid-term momentum with 3-month, 1-month, and 1-week gains of +17.7%, +9.7%, and +10.7%, respectively, indicating a bullish trend. Although the 63-day range position is near the upper end (94%), the persistent uptrend and elevated recent volatility suggest upside potential over the next ~20 trading days. Overall, the trend supports a BUY stance for the medium term.

DECISION: BUY
